program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((sec (lambda (si)
                         (flatmap (lambda (r)
                                    (map (lambda (c) (at g r (+ (* si 5) c)))
                                         (range 0 4)))
                                  (range 0 h))))
                  (classify (lambda (si)
                              (let* ((cells (sec si))
                                     (zeros (filter (lambda (i) (zero? (nth cells i)))
                                                    (range 0 (length cells)))))
                                (if (zero? (length zeros))
                                    2
                                    (let* ((zero-cols (map (lambda (i) (mod i 4)) zeros))
                                           (ucols (unique zero-cols)))
                                      (cond
                                        ((= ucols (list 1 2)) (let ((zero-rows (map (lambda (i) (/ i 4))
                                                                zeros)))
                                            (if (and
                                                  (find (lambda (r) (= r 1)) zero-rows)
                                                  (find (lambda (r) (= r 2)) zero-rows)
                                                  (not (find (lambda (r) (zero? r))
                                                             zero-rows))
                                                  (not (find (lambda (r) (= r 3))
                                                             zero-rows)))
                                                8
                                                4)))
                                        ((= ucols (list 0 3)) 3)
                                        (else 2))))))))
             (build-grid 3 3 (r c) (classify r))))))
